raw.title: Ultranationalism
raw.extract: Ultranationalism, or extreme nationalism, is an extremist form of nationalism in which a country asserts or maintains hegemony, supremacy, or other forms of control over other nations, to pursue its specific interests. Ultranationalist entities have been associated with the engagement of political violence even during peacetime.
